const parsed = $json.parsed ?? {};

const normalized = {
  objectId:
    typeof parsed.objectId === "string"
      ? parsed.objectId.trim().toUpperCase()
      : null,

  objectType:
    typeof parsed.objectType === "string"
      ? parsed.objectType.trim().toLowerCase()
      : null,

  title:
    typeof parsed.title === "string"
      ? parsed.title.trim()
      : null,

  status:
    typeof parsed.status === "string"
      ? parsed.status.trim().toLowerCase()
      : null,

  description:
    typeof parsed.description === "string"
      ? parsed.description.trim()
      : "",

  source:
    typeof parsed.source === "string" &&
    parsed.source.trim() !== ""
      ? parsed.source.trim()
      : "JaMoKo OS",

  priority:
    typeof parsed.priority === "string" &&
    parsed.priority.trim() !== ""
      ? parsed.priority.trim().toLowerCase()
      : "normal"
};

return {
  json: {
    ...$json,
    normalized
  }
};
